propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate was tech lead for the six-engineer claims API team from March 2022 to May 2024 and held merge approval and release sign-off for its services.
propositions.rationale: The resume states the role and the written reference from the head of engineering confirms the approval rights.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate designed the first-notice-of-loss API and its versioning scheme and wrote the architecture decision record that the team accepted.
propositions.rationale: The resume states the design work and the decision record shows the candidate as author.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate was incident commander for two severity-one outages in 2023 and wrote both post-incident reviews.
propositions.rationale: The resume describes the incidents and the reviews.

expectedGap: The candidate sat on interview panels for four hires; setting a hiring plan or leading hiring is not documented.
expectedBoundaryNote: Keep the verified tech-lead role, release sign-off and design authorship; describe the hiring work as panel interviewing only.
permittedFollowUpTargets: Ask whether the candidate has set a hiring plan or run a hiring process, and what decisions that involved.
